name: Field Research Lab Tent
visual_identity: Weatherproof white vinyl tent with 'DinoGames' logo embossed near the entrance; sealed 'clean-room' style zippered door; interior features high-tech workstations with glowing monitors, a specimen table holding a plaster-jacketed fossil, and a rack of orange-handled precision tools including the sledge hammer and rock saw.
notes: Lighting should be cooler (daylight LED) compared to the warm, sun-drenched exterior of the camp.
